name: Get all projects
description: Retrieves all visible projects using the modern paginated Jira API with server-side filtering and pagination support. Results reflect only projects the authenticated user can access — small or empty result sets may indicate permission restrictions, not absence of projects. An empty `values` array means no projects matched the filters; relax `query`, `status`, or `categoryId` if unexpected. Project keys are mutable; prefer the stable numeric project ID for durable references in follow-up calls.

name.description: DEPRECATED: Use 'query' parameter instead. The project name (or part of it) to filter the results. This will be mapped to the 'query' parameter.
name.title: Name

query.description: Filter the results using a query string. Projects with a name or key that contains the query string are returned. The search is case-insensitive. May return multiple partial matches — verify the correct project by exact name or key before using the result. Use the returned project ID or key to pass to tools like JIRA_GET_PROJECT that require a stable identifier.
query.title: Query

action.description: Action types for filtering projects by user permissions.
action.title: ProjectAction

expand.description: A comma-separated list of entities to expand in the response for additional project details. Valid options include: `description` (to include the project description), `issueTypes` (to include all issue types associated with the project), `lead` (to include information about the project lead), and `projectKeys` (to include all project keys associated with the project).
expand.title: Expand

status.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Filter results by project status. Valid values: 'live', 'archived', 'deleted'.
status.title: Status

orderBy.description: Order the results by a field. Valid values: 'category', 'issueCount', 'key', 'lastIssueUpdatedTime', 'name', 'owner', 'archivedDate', 'deletedDate'. Prefix with '-' for descending order.
orderBy.title: Order By

startAt.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset). The base index is 0.
startAt.title: Start At

categoryId.description: The ID of the project category to filter by.
categoryId.title: Category Id

maxResults.description: The maximum number of projects to return per page. Maximum allowed value is 100.
maxResults.title: Max Results

properties.description: A list of project property keys to include in the response for each project, allowing retrieval of custom project entity properties. For example, if a project has a property with key 'com.example.property', including this key here as part of the list will return its value. Provide as a list of strings, e.g., `['property1', 'property2']`.
properties.title: Properties

error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action
error.title: Error

successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
successful.title: Successful
